description:
Configuration schema and OEDISI ComponentParameters for model anonymization.

Attributes:
    name: Optional component or scenario name.
    model_dir: Path to OpenDSS model directory.
    master_file: Name of the master DSS file (e.g. 'master.dss' or 'IEEE123Master.dss').
    output_dir: Optional destination directory for anonymized OpenDSS files.
    in_place: Whether to modify source files in place (mutually exclusive with output_dir).
    noise_level: Relative noise level for numerical parameters (default: 0.05 = +/-5%).
    epsilon: Optional Differential Privacy epsilon parameter.
    salt: Salt string for deterministic SHA-256 pseudonymization.
    seed: Optional integer random seed for reproducible noise generation.
    anonymize_names: Whether to pseudonymize bus and element names.
    anonymize_values: Whether to inject noise into physical parameters (kW, kvar, length, etc.).
    anonymize_loadshapes: Whether to pseudonymize and perturb loadshape profiles.
    validate_powerflow: Whether to verify power flow convergence after anonymization.
    save_mapping: Whether to save name_mapping.json containing original-to-anonymized map.
